name.description: Name in the Sessions list and on the terminal tab.

folder.description: Folder in the Sessions list; use / for sub folders, for example "Prod/Web".

enumDescriptions: SSH port forwarding only (ssh -N), started and stopped from the list

host.description: Server name or address (for ssh, tunnel and rdp).

port.description: Port, if not the default (22 for SSH, 3389 for Remote Desktop).

identityFile.description: Private key file in OpenSSH format, ~ allowed (ssh -i).

jump.description: Jump host(s): user@bastion or user@bastion:port, several separated by commas (ssh -J).

proxy.description: SOCKS5 or HTTP (CONNECT) proxy to reach the server, without authentication. Not used together with a jump host.

forwards.description: Port forwarding: "L 8080:host:80" (local), "R 9000:localhost:9000" (remote), "D 1080" (SOCKS). A bind address can come first: "L 127.0.0.1:8080:host:80".

x11.description: Forward X11 (ssh -X); needs an X server on this PC.

remoteCommand.description: Command to run on the server instead of a login shell.

startDir.description: Folder to start the login shell in on the server.

options.description: Other OpenSSH options, as for ssh -o, for example "StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new".

shell.description: Program of a local shell session.

args.description: Arguments of a local shell session.

color.description: Colour of the session's terminal border (or background, see ddo.sessions.colorStyle), tab and icon. New sessions get one at random; production sessions are always red.

log.description: Save the output of this session to a log file (see ddo.sessions.logFolder).

lastUsed.description: When the session was last opened (milliseconds since 1970).
